riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines practicality, diligence, and the ability to handle a fast pace. Vehicles and watercraft need reliable service, and attendants must balance equipment with live operations.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field rewards practical diligence. Attendants must work quickly and accurately while keeping drivers and boaters comfortable during peak traffic. It suits people who accept responsibility for service and enjoy the full process from arrival to departure.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical and orderly work (Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 勤快 + 能扛节奏」凑一块的人——车船要伺候好也要交得安，设备和现场要平衡也要会盯。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手脚上的勤」——既要做得快、做得准，也要在高峰时把车船伺候舒服。适合务实、勤快、又愿意对服务负责的人，也享受从迎车到送走的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、有序（现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This trade suits people who combine steady hands, physical strength, and safety discipline. In high-temperature, high-pressure steel environments, the work must be both high quality and safe.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The hardest part of this trade is the weight. Components can weigh several tons, spaces are cramped, and a single weld can require hours in an awkward position. It suits people with steady hands who accept dirty work at height and in confined spaces.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on practical work within clear rules (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手稳 + 体力好 + 守安全」凑一块的人——在高温高压的钢铁现场，把活干漂亮也干安全。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨人的是「重」——构件动辄几吨，空间逼仄，焊一道缝要趴半天。适合手稳、不怕脏累、能在高空和密闭里干活的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实操、也愿在规则里做事（现实 R + 常规 C + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most satisfying part is seeing the craft. A roll of carpet becomes a flat, attractive floor, and the owner's satisfaction creates a tangible sense of delivery.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The work makes craftsmanship immediately visible. In your hands, a wrinkled carpet becomes flat, tight, and precisely fitted, and the owner's expression when stepping onto it is the best reward. Every floor plan differs, so no two jobs are exactly the same.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最踏实的是「手艺看得见」：一卷地毯到你手里变成平整漂亮的地面，业主满意地踩上去，那种交付感比啥都实在。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最直接的是「作品看得见」：一块皱巴巴的地毯，在你手里绷得平平整整、严丝合缝，业主踩上去那一刻的表情，就是最好的回报。而且每家的户型不一样，没有两单是完全重复的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine quick hands, a sensitive palate, and composure. At the range during a rush, both pace and flavor must remain steady.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The hardest part of this work is consistency: during a rush, dozens of dishes can leave the kitchen in an hour and still have to taste the same. It suits people who work quickly, stay calm, and tolerate cooking fumes and late nights.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on practical work and cooperation within rules (Realistic R + Conventional C + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手上快 + 味觉灵 + 心里稳」凑一块的人——高峰期的灶台前，节奏和味道都要稳。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨人的是「稳」——高峰期一小时内出几十道菜，味道还得一样。适合手上快、心里稳、扛得住油烟和熬夜的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实操、也愿意在规则里协作（现实 R + 常规 C + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who care about education, can manage others, and remain effective under pressure. The greatest reward is seeing a school operate smoothly and students learn with confidence.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work lies in enabling others to succeed. A well-designed schedule lets teachers teach smoothly, coordinated resources help students learn, and sound management keeps a school stable. People who enjoy working with others, accept responsibility, and can handle desk work can find real purpose in steering a school.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Realistic R

breadcrumb.label: 教育行政管理者、幼儿园中等教育

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「有教育情怀、会管人、又扛得住压力」的人——学校在你手里运转平稳，孩子学得安心，就是最大的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「成就他人」：你排的课表让老师教得顺，你协调的资源让孩子学得好，一所学校在你手里运转平稳。喜欢跟人打交道、愿意担责任、又坐得下来的人，会在这里找到「掌舵一所学校」的分量感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 实际型 R

breadcrumb.label: Farmworkers, Farm, Ranch, And Aquacultural Animals

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who combine stamina with an eye for animals. Live animals require sound care and good health, so workers must monitor conditions closely and judge them accurately.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work demands tolerance for dirt and an eye for animal condition. Workers must perform physical tasks, accept odors, observe animals, and identify problems early. It suits hardworking people who like working with animals and do not want to sit in an office.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, hands-on work (Realistic R).

breadcrumb.label: 农场、牧场与水产养殖农工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「耐劳 + 会看牲口」凑一块的人——活物要好养也要健康，状态要盯紧也要会判。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「耐脏 + 会看牲口」——既要肯干体力活、不怕脏味，也要会观察动物状态、及早发现问题。适合能吃苦、喜欢和动物打交道、也坐不住办公室的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、务实（现实 R）。

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of Entertainment And Recreation Workers, Except Gambling Services

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who enjoy lively settings and accept responsibility. Other people's leisure is your work, but running the venue well creates a satisfying sense of control.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This role is the service industry's control center. Other people see a busy venue; you see schedules, visitor flow, costs, and each resolved crisis. People who enjoy organizing operations, read social situations, and find order in disorder gain a strong sense of control here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 娱乐与休闲业工人一线主管（博彩除外）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「喜欢热闹又担得起责任」的人——别人的休闲是放松，你的休闲是工作，但把场面管明白的掌控感很爽。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行是「服务业的操盘手」：同一个场地，有的人只觉得热闹，你看到的是排班、动线、成本和每一次危机的化解。喜欢管事、会来事、能在混乱里理出头绪的人，会在这里找到掌控感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 事务型 C

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of Mechanics, Installers, And Repairers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine technical skill, on-site authority, and leadership. They need to perform the work, guide others, and carry safety and progress together.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career combines technical work with leadership. Supervisors need hands-on ability, team authority, and shared responsibility for safety and progress. It suits people who understand equipment and enjoy building an effective crew.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, leadership, and investigation (Realistic R + Enterprising E + Investigative I).

breadcrumb.label: 机械安装与维修一线主管

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「技术 + 压场 + 带人」凑一块的人——活要自己会也要带得动，安全和进度要一起扛。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「技术与带人」——活要自己会，人也要带得动，安全和进度要一起扛。适合动手强、能压场、对设备有感觉的人，也享受把班组带顺的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、企业、也研究（现实 R + 企业 E + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits rigorous, curious people who handle pressure. A forensic report can influence how a court understands the facts.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work lies in reconstructing the truth. A usable trace and a defensible finding can redirect an investigation. People who enjoy criminal investigation, can focus in a laboratory, and tolerate difficult samples can find purpose in making evidence speak.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「严谨、好奇、又扛得住压力」的人——你写下的那份报告，可能就决定了正义落在哪一边。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「还原真相」：一条线索能不能用、一份证据站不站得住脚，决定了案子往哪个方向走。喜欢刑侦题材、又坐得住实验室、能接受「脏样本」的人，会在这里找到「让证据说话」的分量感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 实际型 R + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The career suits people who combine investigation, precision, and curiosity. Landscapes must be understood and explained clearly, models must be balanced with field evidence, and good practitioners keep asking questions.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This profession develops the ability to see the world across scales. It combines remote sensing and models with the curiosity to explain spatial questions clearly. It suits investigative, precise people who accept responsibility for data and enjoy understanding a landscape.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative, Realistic, and Artistic interests (I + R + A).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「探究 + 严谨 + 好奇」凑一块的人——地要看得懂也要讲得清，模型与田野要平衡也要敢问。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在尺度间看世界」——既要懂遥感与模型，也要有把空间问题讲清楚的好奇。适合探究、严谨、又愿意对数据负责的人，也享受「看懂一片地」的豁然。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好探究、务实、也艺术（研究 I + 企业 R + 艺术 A）。

breadcrumb.label: Mobile Heavy Equipment Mechanics, Except Engines

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people combining resilience, practicality, and field endurance. Equipment must be restored reliably, balancing tests with hands-on feel and the confidence to act.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops a feel for working with heavy machinery. It requires mechanical and hydraulic knowledge and tolerance for dirt and field conditions, suiting practical, resilient people willing to carry equipment responsibility and who enjoy hearing a machine roar back to life.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical work, investigation, and orderly processes (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「皮实 + 务实 + 能扛野」凑一块的人——设备要修得起来也要修得稳，测试和手感要平衡也要敢下手。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「和铁打交道的手感」——既要懂机械液压，也要耐得住脏和野外。适合务实、皮实、又愿意对设备负责的人，也享受「轰一声起来」的爽感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、探究、也守序（企业 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people whose hands need to stay active. They enjoy taking equipment apart and rebuilding it and feel immediate satisfaction when a failure disappears.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction comes when a failed appliance runs again. Customers move from worry to relief immediately. The work suits people with strong hands-on ability who enjoy independent jobs and accept travel to homes.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手停不下来」的人——喜欢把东西拆开再装好，看到故障被解决就浑身舒坦。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的爽点在于「故障被你修好那一刻」——顾客从满脸愁容到机器正常运转，那种即时成就感很直接。适合动手能力强、喜欢独立干活、不排斥上门跑腿的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most comfortable thing about this industry is that "the tasks are clear and everyone does their own thing": when the order is given, the truck will be dispatched, and every order will be completed one after another, without having to guess people's hearts. Many people like the sense of "stableness" that comes from neatly stacking the goods and making the day safe and accident-free.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This line of work is suitable for people who "like driving but can sit still": you don't have to deal with complex interpersonal relationships, you can drive and work as soon as the task list is given, the goods are neatly arranged, the tasks are completed on time, and you are practical and comfortable at the end of the day.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最舒服的是「任务清楚、各干各的」：单子下来就出车，干完一单是一单，不用揣摩人心。把货码得整整齐齐、一天下来安全无事故，这份「稳稳当当」的踏实感，很多人喜欢。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行适合「喜欢开车又坐得住」的人：不用处理复杂人际，任务单下来就开车干活，货物码得整整齐齐、任务按时完成，一天下来踏实又自在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who treat rigor as a conviction. Every report you sign is evidence of safety, providing a kind of accountability and certainty few occupations offer.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The tangible satisfaction in this work comes from what you protect. A subsea pipeline, nuclear-power valve, or bridge weld you inspected can operate safely for decades, and the passing report in your hand is evidence of that safety.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「严谨」当信仰的人——你签下的每一份报告都是安全证据，这种责任感和确定性，是很多职业给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的踏实感来自「守住了什么」：你测过的那条海底管道、那台核电站阀门、那座大桥的焊缝，可能几十年都在安全运行，而你手上那一张合格报告，就是安全的证据。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 实际型 R + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who treat safety as a conviction. Every bolt you install helps stabilize the roof, and you share responsibility for the safety above underground workers' heads.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The responsibility of this career lies in the safety overhead. Every bolt you install helps keep the roof stable. People who enjoy heavy machinery, tolerate underground conditions, and treat safety first as an iron rule can find a powerful sense of achievement in protecting safety amid danger.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把安全当信仰」的人——你打的每一根锚杆都是顶板稳定的保证，井下工人头顶的安全，有你一份。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的责任感在「头顶上的安全」：你打的每一根锚杆，都是顶板稳定的保证。你喜欢户外和重机械、不怵井下环境、又愿意把「安全第一」当铁律，会在这里找到「在危险里守住安全」的硬核成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 企业型 E

breadcrumb.label: Water And Wastewater Treatment Plant And System Operators

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about water and wastewater treatment operations and are comfortable making judgments under moderate risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to protect compliance limits within pipelines. Operators must understand processes and SCADA, tolerate rotating shifts and repetition, and quickly identify abnormalities. It suits steady, rule-conscious, responsible people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, order, and taking the lead (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 给排水处理厂与系统操作员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Water And Wastewater Treatment Plant And System Operators有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，给排水处理厂与系统操作员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在管线里守住红线」——既要读得懂工艺与 SCADA，也要耐得住倒班与单调，还得在异常时快速定位。适合稳重、守规矩、责任心强的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、秩序、也主导（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who combine attention to detail, interest in experience, and accountability for releases. Pages must look good and work well, balancing visuals and logic through careful debugging.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field most strongly develops judgment between pixels and logic. You need accurate front-end implementation and interaction while aligning with back-end APIs. It suits attentive people who enjoy refining experiences and accept responsibility for releases.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, practical work, and orderly systems (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细致 + 爱琢磨体验 + 对上线负责」凑一块的人——页面要好看也要好用，视觉和逻辑要平衡也要会调。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在像素和逻辑间找手感」——既要懂前端的还原与交互，也要能和后端的接口对上。适合细致、爱琢磨体验、又愿意对上线负责的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好探究、务实也秩序（探究 I + 现实 R + 常规 C）。
